selection_rule: learning.rs excludes retired questions; question_selection.rs receives fresh usable candidates, samples positive-weight nonempty difficulty bands then uniformly within a band. Unknown ratings are fallback only when no weighted rated band remains. Unconfigured selection uses smallest entity ID.
limits: No live learner history, policy weights or future entity IDs; no claim about future learner-specific frequencies. Moderate degree coverage is tested separately because the requested easy delivery band deliberately contains affine inners.
